headline: Brazilian Senate Advances Fiscal Adjustment Package Under Lula Admin
seoTitle: Brazilian Senate Reviews Fiscal Adjustment Package
metaDescription: The Brazilian Senate is set to review the Moretti fiscal package after its base text approval, targeting spending limits and corporate tax reforms.
aiSummaryBullets: The Brazilian Senate is scheduled to discuss the government's fiscal adjustment package this week.
Proposed measures include freezing certain expenditures, restricting tax credit usage, and limiting subsidies.
The legislation also aims to increase tax burdens on mid-sized companies under the presumed profit regime.
aiContextParagraph: The Brazilian government, under the administration of President Lula, has introduced a fiscal package known as the Moretti plan, which seeks to implement structural adjustments to public spending. Following the approval of the bill's base text by the legislature on November 12, 2026, the Senate is preparing to review specific provisions within the package. Key elements of the proposed policy include the establishment of a contingency floor, the authority to freeze additional budget allocations, and the oversight of mandatory expenses. Furthermore, the bill includes provisions to review corporate tax benefits granted in 2025 and to modify the taxation structure for medium-sized enterprises operating under the presumed profit regime. By restricting the application of tax credits to offset obligations and capping government subsidies, the executive branch intends to consolidate fiscal accounts through these regulatory changes currently under legislative debate.
whyItIsViral: The topic is viral due to significant public interest in the country's economic crisis, indicated by high search volume for fiscal measures and legislative progress.
